Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About the Role We match over 90% of our candidates to relevant roles. Getting people through the door isn't the hard part anymore. What happens after is. By year end we'll 5x our candidate pool. Every one of those people generates behavioural signal almost no one else in recruitment holds. Right now, our opportunity lies in how we use that signal to engage and re-engage candidates with the right message at the right moment. This isn't traditional CRM. It's a growth role that lives in the inbox and the product. You'll lead lifecycle inside the growth team: activation, onboarding, education, re-engagement, across email, notifications and in-product. Nobody owns this today. You'll build it from nothing.. In this role you will: Own the lifecycle stack end to end. Choose and implement the right tooling, then build the segmentation, triggers, and cadences that make it an activation engine, not a newsletter. Sequence candidate onboarding sensibly. Design the journeys that take someone from signup to their first valuable actions, faster — the early steps we know predict a candidate sticking around and converting. Turn behavioural signal into personalised journeys. We know things about our users that almost no one else in recruitment does. Make every message feel like it came from someone paying attention. Educate users on the product. Build the communications that help candidates understand and get value from Dex, and partner with marketing to keep the voice consistent across every channel. Own reactivation as a core metric. A lot of value sits in re-engaging users at the right moment in their journey. You’ll build the sequences that do it, and you’ll be measured on it. Build the reporting layer from the ground up. Define what good looks like, instrument it properly, and make lifecycle performance legible to the rest of the company. Keep tests in flight constantly. Kill what doesn’t work quickly, double down on what does, and keep a clear record of what we’ve learned. Report to the Head of Growth and build with product and engineering. The best lifecycle work at Dex lives inside the product, not just the inbox. You’ll shape both. About you You’ve stood up lifecycle or CRM from scratch. Built the engine, not inherited and tended one someone else designed. You come from a consumer tech or software business, where your work centred on the consumer experience and the workflows people actually move through. You think in growth metrics, not marketing metrics. CAC to LTV, unit economics, conversion rate, revenue growth - that’s how you frame your work, not opens and sends. You’re highly technical, analytical, and commercial. You pull your own numbers, spot what matters, and build the case for what to do next without waiting on anyone. You’ve worked hand in hand with growth teams, and you’ve done it at early-stage companies. You’re at home in a small, fast-moving business and you’d take that over big tech. AI fluent. Everyone on this team uses agents to be more effective and execute faster, and you will too. Strong product instinct

jobs.description: 🌍 About Outpost Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it. Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself. Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise. 🧠 The Role We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO. We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate. Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up. This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better. 🧩 What You'll Do Own the CEO's diary and logistics Run scheduling day to day - booking, moving, protecting focus time, resolving clashes before they become problems Book and manage international travel, and rebuild it when a flight moves Prepare meeting packs: who's in the room, what they want, what happened last time Track and chase the follow-ups nobody wrote down Do the work he never sees The highest-value work here is invisible. jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the Founders
jobs.description: We are hiring an Executive Assistant to the Founders to own the calendars, correspondence, travel, and follow-through of our two co-founders. Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast. The role The two co-founders carry the work that decides this company: product, clients, the investor network, the brand. Their time is the scarcest resource in the business, and protecting it will be your mandate. You manage both calendars across time zones, own both inboxes, plan and oversee travel, prepare the founders for the meetings that matter, and ensure every commitment they make is kept. This is a position of ownership, not a list of tasks. You exercise judgment, act independently, and involve the founders only when a decision genuinely requires them. You work AI-first, like the rest of the company: tooling carries the mechanical work, and your time goes to judgment, anticipation, and trust. You report directly to both co-founders and hold one of the most trusted positions in the company. What you will own Both calendars across time zones: scheduling, conflicts resolved before they surface, preparation time protected, and our Monday and Thursday meeting rhythm maintained. Both inboxes: triaged daily, replies drafted in each founder's voice, nothing important left waiting. Travel end to end: planned, booked, briefed, and resolved in real time when plans change. Meeting preparation and follow-through: the right briefing beforehand, actions captured and pursued afterward. The commitment layer: what the founders have promised, to whom, by when, tracked to completion. The systems behind it all, built on the best AI tooling, so mechanical work never requires attention twice. You are a fit if you Have supported a founder or C-level executive at a fast-moving company, and can describe what never required their attention because of you. Have managed calendars across three or more time zones and understand the craft: buffers, batching, protected working time, and declining requests on someone else's behalf with grace. Write well enough to draft in another person's voice, and judge well enough to know what can be sent without asking. Have owned travel end to end, including disruptions resolved before the principal ever felt them. Can support two principals at once: competing priorities held, both agendas moving, neither founder resolving minor conflicts. Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always. Build systems rather than task lists: standing rhythms, documented processes, and automation that outlasts your busiest week. Operate with modern tooling: AI runs your scheduling, briefings, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment rather than administration. What we offer Fully remote. This position operates in real time across the founders' working day rather than asynchronously. Meetings across the company batch on Mondays and Thursdays, and you are the one who maintains that rhythm. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct trust from both co-founders, full visibility into the company, and a position that grows as the company does. How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Please do not include the names of former principals or any of their confidential matters; we evaluate how you work, not who you have worked for. jobs.title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll? 🚀 Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in  mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit  zum Einsatz. Als  Systemadministrator Linux  verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten.  Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf  Linux und Open Source . In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner  Linux basierter KI Server  kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.  Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen.  Deine Benefits Gestaltungsspielraum:  Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.   Spannende Zukunftsprojekte:  Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.   Direkte Zusammenarbeit:  Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.   Flexibles Arbeiten:  Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel  einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice . Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein.  30 Urlaubstage:  Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.   Bonus:  Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.   Mobilität:  Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.   Sport & Gesundheit:  Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.   Team & Events:  Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.   Weiterentwicklung:  Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.   Gehalt:  Jahresbruttogehalt ab  60.000 €  mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung.  Deine Aufgaben Als  Systemadministrator Linux  hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens.  Linux & Infrastruktur:  Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.   Open Source:  Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrat

jobs.title: Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The role We’re looking for a Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d) to join our team and play a key role in developing software that connects and translates lab equipment hardware interfaces, automates machines, and powers our next-generation automation platform. As a core team member, you will be working on cutting-edge technology, building software that bridges the gap between software and hardware, enabling seamless integration across various vendors. Connectors are how we do it. Every instrument we bring online gets one, and every connector is built on our shared Python libraries: Bus, our Connector Development Kit, and the stack underneath them. Our mission is to empower researchers and engineers by bridging the gap between lab equipment and cloud-based automation. Our customers are solving critical challenges like curing diseases, developing sustainable materials, and addressing global food security. We provide them with the tools to connect their devices, automate workflows, and unlock new possibilities in R&D. Your mandate has two halves. Own the libraries as a product with real users, our own engineers today and external contributors later. And stay close enough to customer connector work that what you build is grounded in problems that actually exist. Why you'll love this role Your users are engineers. Your success lets other people ship connectors faster. That's a different craft from shipping features, and it's the one we're hiring for. Real hardware, real failure modes. Instruments time out, return garbage, and arrive with documentation that's wrong. You'll debug against physical devices in our Munich workshop. Open source on purpose. Our CDK and our standardization work ( SiLA 2) are public. What you build gets used and criticized by people outside the company. Senior scope, small team. You'll be the person who decides how connector engineering works here. No layer between you and that decision. Your mission 1. The Builder: own the shared libraries Own Bus, the CDK, and the core stack. Features, tests, CI, releases, and deprecations across the connectors already running in production. Extract abstractions from real work. When the same pattern shows up in the third connector, it becomes a library feature. You're the one who notices, and the one who does it. Make the docs good enough to remove yourself. An outside contributor should be able to build a connector on our libraries without a call. Set the quality standard. You define what "tested" means before a connector reaches a customer, and you make it stick. 2. The Shipper: build connectors on real instruments Ship production connectors end to end. Spec sheet, physical device, protocol, proof of connectivity, tested connector, live customer. Independently. Reverse-engineer what isn't documented. Roughly half the instruments we touch have incomplete or wrong docs. Packet captures, trial and error, vendor calls. Work with the workshop. Our Connector Factory team gets instruments development-ready. You take it from there. Talk to the people who use it. Automation engineers and scientists at biotech and pharma customers. Their constraints shape what the libraries need next. Your profile Deep Python: 5+ years of writing production Python other people depend on. Async, typing, packaging, testing. You've designed APIs that other engineers built on, not just glue code. You've debugged a real protocol against real hardware: gRPC, serial, TCP, OPC UA, CAN, USB. Which one matters less than having sat with a packet capture and a device that won't respond. You ship without a spec: When the documentation is wrong, you reverse-engineer, instead of filing a vendor ticket and waiting. You build for other developers: An SDK, a library, an internal platform. Something where your job was making other engineers faster. Located in Munich: The instruments are physically here at WERK1. Nice to have SiLA 2, or another device abstraction and interoperability standard Lab a

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ⭐️ Your Impact: The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to deliver the energy transition. There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't last. smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working. These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging. That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker. That's what this role is for. What you'll do You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team - and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day. - Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed. - Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs. - Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability, evaluation, structured output, graceful failure. - Decide what to build. You'll write your own acceptance criteria. Nobody here will hand you a spec, and waiting for one is how to fail in this role. - Measure whether it worked. Hours saved per partner, offers that go out untouched, leads answered before a competitor picks up. If the number didn't move, it didn't work. What that looks like in practice In July one of our Meister got an early build of the partner app, ahead of the general rollout. He tested it between jobs and sent screenshots: from a calendar appointment he could no longer jump into the project to pull the customer's phone number. He had a reply in two minutes. Within the hour he'd also asked for a navigation button - tap the address, go straight to maps. Neither was news. Both were already being worked on before he hit send. We aim to be fast, and close enough to the work that we've usually seen the problem before the person living it has to tell us. ✨ What Makes You a Great Fit: You might be a great fit if you - Have owned something end to end - architecture through delivery through the unglamorous iteration afterwards. We don't count years; we look at what you carried. - Get obsessed with a problem rather than a stack. The tools change every few months. The curiosity compounds. - Would rather ship something that changes a tradesperson's week than win an argument about abstractions. - Actually like talking to customers, and have changed your mind about a feature because of something a user said. - Are comfortable being the least knowledgeable person in a room full of electricians, and ask the question anyway. - Can hold "ship it today" and "this needs to survive two years" in your head at the same time, and know which one applies. Our stack, so you know what you're walking into: - Backend: Python, FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL (with pgvector), Celery, Redis - Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, PrimeVue - Mobile: Flutter - AI: Anthropic, Open source and Google models, vector search over partner and catalog data - Infra: Google Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Sentry We care that you're strong somewhere and unafraid everywhere else. If you've never written Vue but you've shipped production systems and you learn fast, that is fine - several of u

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) – du machst Partner erfolgreich
jobs.description: Über TREELAX Partner TREELAX Partner ist die führende Branchensoftware für Baumpflegebetriebe in Deutschland. Ein komplettes ERP, das den ganzen Betrieb abbildet. Wir heißen nicht zufällig Partner . Wir verstehen uns als Digitalisierungspartner unserer Betriebe, betreuen sie intensiv und kennen jeden einzelnen. Wir arbeiten deutschlandweit aus dem Homeoffice, und KI steckt in allem, was wir tun. Genervt von der üblichen Servicekultur in Deutschland? Willst du zeigen, wie guter Service wirklich geht, und die Extra-Meile gehen? Unsere Partner sind Baumpflegebetriebe, die oft mit Zettel, Excel und Bauchgefühl arbeiten. Für viele ist unsere Software der erste echte Schritt in die digitale Welt. Manche sind schon bei der ersten Videokonferenz unsicher. Genau diese Menschen holst du ab, führst sie und machst sie erfolgreich. Und zwar nicht nur in den ersten Wochen. Du bleibst dauerhaft ihr fester Ansprechpartner. Du betreust vor allem kleine und mittlere Betriebe, langfristig bis zu 100 Partner, und sorgst dafür, dass sie sich jederzeit gut aufgehoben fühlen. Was du machst Du nimmst neue Partnerbetriebe an die Hand. Du richtest ihr System ein, schulst sie und begleitest sie, remote per Video, bis der Umstieg leicht von der Hand geht. Du bleibst dauerhaft ihr Ansprechpartner. Du beantwortest Fragen geduldig und verständlich und machst aus „kompliziert“ ein „ach, so einfach“. Du begleitest Veränderung. Du bringst Menschen dazu, alte Gewohnheiten loszulassen. Du gehst mit unterschiedlichen Betriebskulturen um und nimmst Widerstände gegen Neues ernst, statt sie zu übergehen. Du bist Erfolgsmanager und Lotse. Das beste System nützt nichts, wenn es niemand nutzt. Du sorgst dafür, dass deine Partner es wirklich einsetzen und dadurch erfolgreicher werden. Läuft ein Partner richtig gut, erkennst du, wo noch mehr für ihn möglich ist, etwa eine professionelle Website oder Online-Marketing. Du sprichst es an, immer vom echten Mehrwert her und ohne Verkaufsdruck. Wir richten uns nach dem Partner, nicht umgekehrt. Das heißt auch: flexible Arbeitszeiten. Manche Baumpfleger haben erst morgens vor der Baustelle oder abends danach Zeit. Wenn du bereit bist, dich darauf einzustellen, machst du genau den Unterschied, den unsere Partner bei uns lieben. Was du verdienst 60.000 € Fixgehalt. Erfolgsbonus für Partner, die durch dich erfolgreich starten und aktiv bleiben. Upsell-Provision , wenn ein Partner durch dich mehr Wert zieht. Zielgehalt rund 70.000 €. Deutschlandweit aus dem Homeoffice. Was du mitbringst Echten Servicegedanken. Guter Service ist für dich Anspruch, nicht lästige Pflicht. Du gehst gern die Extra-Meile. Echtes Interesse an Menschen und einen guten Draht zu Praktikern. Du sprichst die Sprache von Machern. Fingerspitzengefühl für Veränderung. Du spürst, wann jemand skeptisch ist, und holst ihn ab, statt ihn zu überfahren. Geduld und Köpfchen. Du erklärst Kompliziertes einfach und denkst dich mit Freude in ein breites System hinein, bis du es wirklich verstehst. Verlässlichkeit. Worauf du dich einlässt, ziehst du sauber durch. Eine eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, zeitliche Flexibilität und sehr gutes Deutsch. Du musst nicht aus der grünen Branche kommen. Aber du willst sie kennenlernen. Baumpflege hat eine eigene Sprache und eine überraschend tolle Gemeinschaft. Wir bieten dir sogar einen Praxistag bei einem unserer Partner vor Ort, damit du weißt, wovon du sprichst. Vorerfahrung ist kein Muss. Entscheidend ist die Bereitschaft, dich auf Neues einzulassen, genau wie unsere Partner sich auf die Software einlassen müssen. Wann wir NICHT zusammenpassen Sei ehrlich zu dir. Wir passen nicht zusammen, wenn du … … guten Service als lästige Pflicht statt als Anspruch siehst. … nur Systeme einrichten willst, aber keine Lust hast, Menschen zu führen und mitzunehmen. … bei Widerstand oder Skepsis schnell die Geduld verlierst. … eine starre 9-bis-17-Uhr-Routine brauchst und dich nicht mal auf einen frühen oder späten Termin einlässt. … nic

jobs.description: About Peec AI Peec AI is the visibility platform for the age of AI search. The way people discover brands is being rewritten. ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Mode and Copilot now sit between companies and their customers, and most brands have no idea what those models say about them. We built the platform marketing teams use to measure, understand and improve how they show up inside AI answers. We went from 0 to $10M ARR in 16 months. We're around 80 people, based in Berlin with a growing presence in New York, and we're moving fast enough that the people joining now are writing the playbook everyone after them will run. Measuring the problem is only the first half. The second half is software that acts: agents that watch what a brand is doing across AI search, surface what matters, and then do the work. We're building that agent layer from the ground up, and this PM will define and own it. What You'll Do Own the agentic product surface at Peec AI, from the harness itself to the experience built around it Build agents that act proactively on customer data, alongside a pod of data scientists, AI engineers and a frontend engineer Work directly with our largest agency and brand customers, building specific agents for a handful of them first and scale it further to other users Turn what works for those first customers into product everyone can use Hold a high bar on interface quality Who You Are You have built an agent harness or a proactive agentic system, something that looks at a user's data or the work in front of them and then does the work rather than just suggesting it Your agent experience is in a B2B or prosumer context 3+ building excellent software products, ideally at a startup or fast-moving company Real working experience alongside data scientists and AI engineers. jobs.description: View All Jobs Do you love turning messy behavioral data into the "aha" that changes a product roadmap? Do you want your dashboards to be the first thing product leaders open in the morning — and your analyses to inform what gets built next? If so, we want to talk to you! About the Role Updater operates at the intersection of embedded commerce, consumer marketplaces, and AI-powered buyflows. Millions of consumers use our products to find and purchase internet, utilities, insurance, moving services, and more — and every click, invite, and order tells a story. The story involves difficult consumer choices, understanding what product fits their needs. On the other side of the marketplace there’s also provider complexity about what consumers represent good credit risks. Your job is to find both sides of the story and make changes actionable. As our Lead Data Analyst for Product Analytics, you'll own how we measure product performance across Updater's product lines — from our consumer Moving App and Pro Onboarding for multifamily residents, to PoweredBy embedded commerce and our Marketplace, to our newest AI agentic experiences. You'll build the reporting that tracks our most important KPIs — funnel conversion, order rate, claim rate, engagement — and go beyond the "what" to explain the "why," shaping experiments and roadmaps along the way. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership seat. You'll partner directly with multiple product teams, along with marketing, and customer success. Your insights will inform decisions from feature design to executive strategy. We're also aggressively leaning into AI: we've been developing LLM-based agentic experiences that help consumers purchase complex products with confidence, and our data teams use Claude Code and other LLM-based tools daily to move faster and dig deeper. If you're excited to practice analytics at the frontier, you'll be at home here. What You'll Own KPI reporting & dashboards — Define, build, and maintain the Looker dashboards that track funnel conversion and key product KPIs across product lines, so every team shares one trusted view of performance. Product performance analysis — Investigate user behavior across the full journey (invite → onboarding → active usage → conversion) to explain why metrics move and where the biggest opportunities hide. Experimentation — Design and analyze A/B tests that are statistically sound and trusted for business decisions, partnering with product and marketing to raise conversion across our buyflows. Data modeling — Build and maintain dbt models in Snowflake that power self-serve analytics and keep metric definitions consistent and reliable. Roadmap planning & impact sizing — Size opportunities and quantify the impact of launches so product teams invest in the highest-leverage work. Partner & external reporting — Own recurring performance reporting for key enterprise partners, in collaboration with customer success. Incident support & ad hoc insights — Monitor product health, help spot anomalies before they hit the business, and answer high-stakes questions with fast, rigorous analysis. What Success Looks Like Every product line has clearly defined KPIs with dashboards stakeholders trust — even when the numbers are uncomfortable. When funnel conversion moves, we know why within hours, not weeks. Product roadmaps are informed by your opportunity sizing and experiment results. A/B tests across the company are statistically fair and consistently interpreted. Partner-facing reports ship accurately and on time, every time. About You Product sense : you think like a designer and a strategist — you see the opportunity behind the metric, not just the metric. Comfort with ambiguity : you consistently deliver results from open-ended questions, without waiting for a perfectly scoped ticket. Strong communication : you tailor your message to your audience, whether that's an executive, an engineer, or a non-technical partner. Relationship bu

jobs.title: AWS Data Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. This is a senior role in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters, at meaningfully lower engagement cost than traditional data consulting. Customers come to us after a data program has stalled pipelines nobody trusts, warehouses nobody runs new workloads on, a modernization that produced diagrams instead of production systems. Aedeon handles automated source discovery, schema mapping, lineage extraction, and parallel-run validation. You own what agents can't: target architecture, data model decisions, pipeline design under real constraints, and the calls that make a cutover safe. You'll build with PySpark and SQL on EMR and Glue, model for Redshift, Snowflake, Athena, and Presto, orchestrate with Airflow and your work will reach production, not a slide deck. What you will do? Build and maintain data pipelines on Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue that run in production. Design data models and end-user querying on Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. Build and maintain pipeline orchestration with Airflow. Work with customer and internal teams to understand data needs and design the solutions that meet them. Troubleshoot and optimize pipelines and data models until they hold up under real load. Write and maintain PySpark and SQL scripts to extract, transform, and load data. Document and communicate technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences — customers sign off on what we ship. Track new AWS data technologies and judge their impact on the systems we run. What are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience working with PySpark and SQL. 2+ years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue. 2+ years of experience with data modeling and end-user querying using Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. 1+ years of experience building and maintaining pipeline orchestration using Airflow. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment. You are preferred if you have AWS Data Analytics Specialty Certification Experience with Agile development methodology How we work? We run a forward-deployed model. Senior engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally fixed dates, with Mactores absorbing overage cost for delays inside our control. Aedeon absorbs scale; you absorb judgment. That means less of your week goes to inventory spreadsheets and manual validation, and more goes to architecture, data modeling, and cutover strategy. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We measure ourselves by what ships. Compensation Additional Information Life at Mactores We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work. 1. Be one step ahead 2. Deliver the best 3. Be bold 4. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - French (FR)
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in French & English. Resident in France for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.title: New Business Manager
jobs.description: Our company Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search - across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form. Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs. Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries. We’re a remote-first company , but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕). About the role We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process." On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side: working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn. You will be responsible for: Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting. Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies. Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency or at a company selling into agencies. Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting. Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs). No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing. Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that. Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools (we use HubSpot). Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above). jobs.description: Are you knowledgeable about religion or religious studies and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of interpreting historical texts, analyzing belief systems, and supporting comparative and cultural understanding. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve religious literacy, support education, and provide more accurate cultural and historical context. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as world religions, theology, religious history, philosophy of religion, comparative religion, sacred texts, and cultural or anthropological perspectives on belief systems. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as interpretation of religious texts, historical context, doctrinal differences, ethical frameworks, religious practices, and interfaith perspectives—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and cultural accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with religious or historical scenarios, analytical and interpretive questions, and cultural context tasks; evaluate accuracy and neutrality; verify logical consistency; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and reasoning quality. You may also help identify where models oversimplify beliefs, misinterpret texts, or present inaccurate historical or cultural information. A degree in religious studies, theology, history, anthropology, or a related humanities field is preferred but not required. Entry-level candidates with coursework, independent study, teaching experience, or a strong personal or academic interest in religion and cultural studies are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and interpretive steps (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of religion into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support education, cultural understanding, and responsible interpretation of complex topics. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. jobs.description: Description 🤓At TripleTen , we're building an international platform of digital re-skilling products to help people from diverse backgrounds learn new professions and build sustainable careers in tech. Our program graduates have landed jobs at top companies like Tesla, Spotify, PlayStation, Google, and Microsoft. So far, over 5,000 students have chosen TripleTen , and hundreds of new students are joining us each month. We believe everyone can jumpstart a new career, which is why we produce quality educational content and offer intensive courses in tech complete with full access to an interactive platform, code reviews, and support from industry practitioners. We're launching a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. The curriculum is being built by a team of senior authors. What we need now is the person who brings it to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the architecture review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. This is a teaching and review role. You'll be the senior technical presence the cohort learns from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real architectural feedback on student deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually designed and shipped systems at scale, has opinions about what good architecture looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their design is wrong, not just whether it runs. Your audience: experienced engineers leveling up to system architecture roles. Many already write production code daily. They will spot shallow feedback instantly, so the bar here is real seniority, not familiarity. Format: Async-first with scheduled live sessions. Live sessions and office hours are timed around a US-based cohort. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week. Please submit all resumes or CV's in English. What you will do Host weekly live sessions across the program, focused on the design and decision layer: where to split services, how systems scale and fail, which tradeoff to make and why Run group office hours and 1:1 sessions for students working through projects and the capstone Review student projects against rubrics: the architecture dossiers, deployed backends, cloud infrastructure, performance reports, security reviews, and the final distributed-system capstone Give architectural feedback, not just pass/fail checks. Catch when a design decision is unsound, an interface is wrong, or a scope is unrealistic, and explain the better path Run the mock architecture review boards and the simulated executive-panel presentations, and give structured, senior-level critique Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point on design and architecture calls Requirements 5+ years as a senior software/systems architect, platform engineer, or senior backend/infrastructure engineer Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company, not just coursework or side projects Depth across the architectural spine: system design, API and service architecture, cloud and infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD), and distributed systems Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's architecture live Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work What we can offer you Milestone-based payments tied to deliverables Fully remote work with flexible hours A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging The chance to see

jobs.description: Description The Technical Support Engineer ensures the reliability and performance of deployed systems. In this hands-on role, you'll troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues across the full stack — networking, edge devices, and cloud-connected components and partner closely with field teams, engineering, and QA to drive technical resolution, documentation, and system robustness. May be leveled as Tech Support Engineer I / II depending on experience, scope, and demonstrated impact. Evening and late-night shifts are eligible for shift differential pay. Maintain reliable, secure, and scalable network and infrastructure environments across cloud and hybrid deployments. Maintain networking components including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, and WAN connectivity.
